description:
Our focus is “Flame in Freefall: AI-Powered Fire Safety Insights from Microgravity Combustion Data.” We’re exploring how AI can help make complex microgravity combustion research easier to understand, analyze, and turn into useful fire-safety insights.

We’re especially interested in teammates with skills in AI/ML, data science, data visualization.
summary: FlameLens is an AI-powered research intelligence platform developed to support the study of fire behaviour and combustion in microgravity. It addresses the challenges of accessing and understanding scientific research related to spacecraft fire safety by bringing NASA combustion research documents into one centralized platform. Using document extraction, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), ChromaDB, and a Django-based interface, FlameLens allows users to explore research material, retrieve relevant scientific evidence, and interact with an AI-assisted research system. The project aims to make microgravity combustion knowledge more accessible and support research that contributes to safer future space missions.
details:
What FlameLens Does

FlameLens is a research intelligence platform designed to make microgravity combustion research easier to explore and understand. It brings NASA research documents into a centralized environment and uses an AI-assisted Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflow to retrieve relevant scientific information.

How It Works

The platform processes research documents and extracts their text and relevant information. The extracted content is divided into smaller sections, converted into embeddings, and stored in ChromaDB. When a user asks a question, the system searches the knowledge base for relevant evidence and passes the retrieved information to a language model to generate a research-based response with source references.

Users can explore research material, ask scientific questions, review retrieved sources, and investigate combustion-related findings.

Technology Used

- Python and Django for backend development

- HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for the interface

- ChromaDB for vector storage and retrieval

- Sentence Transformers for local text embeddings

- Gemini API for language-model integration

- Document extraction libraries for PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, and other supported formats

- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for evidence-based responses

Intended Impact

FlameLens aims to improve access to scientific knowledge about flame behaviour in microgravity, support the exploration of combustion experiments, and help researchers better understand information relevant to spacecraft fire safety. It is a research-support prototype, not a certified operational spacecraft fire-safety system.
